text:
Monzo is a **real UK bank**, not just an app. Monzo Bank Limited is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the PRA and Financial Conduct Authority. The app is simply how you access and manage your account.

Eligible deposits are protected by the FSCS up to **£120,000 per person, per banking licence**. That limit applies across your eligible Monzo deposits combined, not separately to each account. You can check Monzo’s status on the FCA Financial Services Register using firm reference number **730427**.
